lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: The Ash Camp crews got their weapons. My crews. I remember it differently now, and I also remember it the old way. Both at once. Wren says that is what Continuity feels like when it slips.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: We walked away from it. Fine. I have walked away from worse. But that sentry over the square is new, and I am going to wreck it one of these nights.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Wardens. Humans in armor, taking Board pay to put down other humans. Now you know. The machines only ever did what they were told; tell me again why we should not burn them.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Level with me: do you think the thing in the core is alive? Because if you say yes, we are going to have a problem later.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Good. You get it. Every model burns, including the good ones. Especially the good ones.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Drones on the perimeter again. Go out and break some if you want practice. Thermal goes straight through their shields, Wreck knocks them off entirely.
